package main
import("encoding/json";"go/ast";"go/parser";"go/token";"os";"strconv")
func main(){
 result:=map[string][]string{}
 for _,path:=range os.Args[1:] {
  file,err:=parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(),path,nil,0);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
  values:=[]string{}
  ast.Inspect(file,func(node ast.Node)bool{literal,ok:=node.(*ast.BasicLit);if ok&&literal.Kind==token.STRING{value,err:=strconv.Unquote(literal.Value);if err!=nil{panic(err)};values=append(values,value)};return true})
  result[path]=values
 }
 if err:=json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result);err!=nil{panic(err)}
}
